title: Specs Supplemental Sidecar
description: What a component needs beyond what the spec can carry, registered beside the spec as components/<component>/supplemental.yaml. Overlay-only: every entry names the schema path that cannot carry it; anything the schema can carry belongs in the spec. EXPERIMENTAL — this contract is CLI-defined while authoring rounds prove the shape; it is expected to move into @directededges/specs-schema once stable.

Section.description: Entries for one concern the spec cannot fully carry.

intent.description: A testable statement of what the component must do — written to transfer directly to a test-case criterion. No rationale prose.

schemaGap.description: The schema path or definition that would carry this requirement, and why it cannot. Named, not asserted — an entry that cannot name its gap belongs in the spec.

platforms.description: Where the overlay is implemented, per platform — a file path relative to the component's folder in that platform's tree. Absent while the entry is pending implementation.

regenerationRisk.description: What a re-emit could break and how to re-check it. Updated after every regeneration — this field is the ledger of manual work that must be re-verified.
